margin_definition: g_i^(q)=v_MD^T(h_i^T-q - h_i^F-q), with the fixed FP16-trained unit MD direction.
margin_sign_convention: Positive means the correct candidate has the larger fixed-direction score.
relative_shrinkage_definition: (mean_i g_i^(FP16) - mean_i g_i^(q)) / mean_i g_i^(FP16); it is a ratio of means, not a mean of per-pair ratios.
flip_definition: count(sign(g_i^(FP16)) != sign(g_i^(q))) over all held-out pairs.
zero_margin_treatment: sign(0)=0; zero margins are retained and count as flips only when the other margin has a nonzero sign.
excluded_pair_rule: No extra pair-level exclusions: each frozen held-out split is used after source artifact ID/order validation.
auroc_drop_definition: AUROC_FP16 - AUROC_quantized using correct and incorrect candidates as independent scored samples.
